info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Logistics Shipments Create-v1-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Creation API facilitates the submission of new shipments within the logistics management system. This endpoint allows users to efficiently create and register shipment details including origin, destination, and package specifications. Ideal for logistics providers and supply chain managers, this API enhances operational workflows by automating the shipment creation process. Typical consumers include warehouse managers, shipping coordinators, and third-party logistics providers looking to streamline their shipping operations.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new shipment by providing necessary details such as destination, weight, and shipment type. Ensure all required fields are filled out before submitting the request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new shipment. It should include all necessary details about the shipment, such as sender and recipient information, package dimensions, weight, and shipping options.
